name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Adding a friend now asks what you want: a prompt lists their libraries (what you receive) and yours (what you share with them), and nothing is pulled in until you save. Previously every library they had was selected automatically. Unticking a friend's library now removes the items it brought in, right when you save: before, unticking a friend's last library in a section such as Music left their items behind until you removed the whole section.
